verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own release tracking: the CLI handles 'release and source maps management', there are deploy notifications, and 'Suspect commits' tie issues to code changes. That gives a documented base for correlating errors with deploys, but no evidence shows a per-release regression view or tracking of configuration and feature-flag changes; the LaunchDarkly integration only adds Sentry errors as an experiment metric. missing for 10: explicit docs showing regressions correlated to specific releases or deploys, configuration or feature-flag change tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments.
Automatically notify Sentry of new Bitbucket Pipelines builds.
